title: Edit record
purpose: Edit a durable record without losing work.
useWhen: A record has editable fields and an explicit persistence operation.
avoidWhen: Use InlineEdit for a contextual single value; use a route for extended work.
alternatives: Use InlineEdit for a contextual single value; use a route for extended work.
requiredInputs: save promise returning canonical persisted value
transitions: pending → success only after current response; newer edits remain dirty
applicability: A record has editable fields and an explicit persistence operation.
exceptions: Require only states supported by the application; do not fabricate capabilities.
